scenes.setting: The Moon pays in history: the Blood Moon Queen Auernia, wife of the Night Emperor, before whom Augustus and Einhorn said 'Your Majesty' — and the War of the Four Emperors that killed her and drove the Sanguine into the mountains; the eager lecture is cut short and traded forward, and the secret-deed ritual is granted
scenes.text_anchor: our queen, Blood Moon Queen, Auernia

scenes.setting: At the Harvest Church, oddly relaxed, Emlyn notices something he never had: Father Utravsky has never once stopped him from hunting for a cure
scenes.text_anchor: What exactly is on his mind…

scenes.setting: The greasy coffee shop: two pounds paid in advance for the 'holiday' weeks ahead, and warnings — take no risks in a restless East Borough, and get Liv's family somewhere safe if anything breaks out

Among his dolls behind drawn curtains, Emlyn performs the secret deed — glimpsing the shadows, the seven lights, the fog and a golden black-winged figure — and screams, smoking green, as the psychological cue burns away under the Sun Brooch

Divinations about visiting Red Rose Manor return nothing at all, today or tomorrow — proof enough of what waits there — so the decision is made unaided: go now, and exit the stage before it becomes impossible
scenes.text_anchor: I have to decide on my own…
